## Accessibility Checklist Results (Required for UX PRs)

If this PR changes any UX, screen layout, interaction behavior, or visual component, complete the checklist below (copy from `docs/accessibility_pr_checklist.md`):

- [ ] Tab order is logical and complete
- [ ] Focus visibility is clear
- [ ] Color contrast is sufficient
- [ ] Status cues are not color-only
- [ ] Keyboard-only completion works end-to-end
